provenance.source: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) arts. 19, 20, 57-61, 63, 66, 68.3; Ley 7/2024 (escala del ahorro); Orden PJC/297/2026 (bases de cotizacion)
provenance.notes: Figures transcribed from the build specification and from consolidated BOE text. NOT machine-verified against the AEAT Manual Practico. Verify every value before shipping.

verificationTodo: socialSecurity.monthlyMaxBase - the 2025 value (4909.50) is carried forward. Confirm the 2026 figure in Orden PJC/297/2026 (BOE 31-03-2026).
reduccionRendimientosTrabajo - amounts follow art. 20 LIRPF as amended by RDL 20/2022. Confirm whether a later SMI-linked update applies for 2026.
minimos - confirm the arts. 57-61 amounts are unchanged for 2026.
omissions: Cotizacion adicional de solidaridad on earnings above the maximum base (in force since 2025) is not modelled.
Increased otros gastos for unemployed persons relocating (+2000) and for workers with a disability (3500 / 7750) are not modelled.
Halving of descendant minimums under shared custody is not modelled.

stateScale.note: State half of the general scale. The familiar 19/24/30/37/45/47 table is the withholding reference of art. 101.1 LIRPF and is NOT the liability scale.

savingsScale.note: Combined state plus regional savings scale. Identical in every comunidad de regimen comun. The 30% top band above 300.000 EUR applies from 01-01-2025.

socialSecurity.note: Employee share only. The MEI employee share is 0.15% in 2026 (0.90% total, 0.75% employer). The maximum base is MONTHLY, so the cap is applied month by month and then summed.

reduccionRendimientosTrabajo.note: Full amount at or below the floor, linear taper of 1,14 x (net work income - floor) up to the ceiling, zero above. The reduction may not exceed the net work income.

pensionPlan.note: Individual contributions are capped at the lower of 30% of net work and business income or 1.500 EUR. Employer contributions can raise the joint limit to 8.500 EUR and are out of scope in v1.

donations.legalRef: Art. 68.3 LIRPF y art. 19 Ley 49/2002, redaccion RDL 6/2023

inputSchema.label: Rendimiento integro del trabajo (gross salary, per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross pay before any deduction, month by month. Leave a month blank if you had no employment income then - a partial year is taxed on the actual total and is never annualised.

inputSchema.label: Tipo de contrato
inputSchema.help: Sets the unemployment contribution rate within your employee social security share.

inputSchema.label: Seguridad Social withheld (optional override, per month)
inputSchema.help: Leave blank and the app computes the employee share from your gross. Fill it in only if your payslip shows a different figure.

inputSchema.label: Retencion de IRPF on each payslip (per month)
inputSchema.help: IRPF actually withheld. Used only for the final refund or amount owing - it never changes the liability.

inputSchema.label: Rendimientos del capital mobiliario (savings base)
inputSchema.help: Interest and dividends, taxed on the separate savings scale. Capital gains are out of scope in v1.

inputSchema.label: Aportaciones a planes de pensiones
inputSchema.help: Your own contributions to a qualifying pension plan. Capped at the lower of 30% of net work income or 1.500 EUR.

inputSchema.label: Cuotas sindicales (union dues)
inputSchema.help: Union dues are deductible in full as a gasto, with no cap.

inputSchema.label: Cuotas de colegios profesionales
inputSchema.help: Deductible only where membership is compulsory for your job, and only up to 500 EUR a year.

inputSchema.label: Gastos de defensa juridica
inputSchema.help: Legal costs of a dispute with your employer over the employment relationship. Capped at 300 EUR a year.

inputSchema.label: Donativos (Ley 49/2002 entities)
inputSchema.help: Only gifts to qualifying NGOs, foundations and public bodies. A gift to a private individual or a crowdfunding page does not qualify.

inputSchema.label: Recurring donation to the same entity
inputSchema.help: Tick only if you gave to the same entity in each of the two previous years, at least matching the previous year. Raises the rate above 250 EUR from 40% to 45%.

inputSchema.label: Age on 31 December
inputSchema.help: Drives the age uplift on the personal minimum (65+ and 75+).

inputSchema.label: Children under 25 living with you
inputSchema.help: Descendants under 25 (any age if disabled) living with you whose own income is under 8.000 EUR. Amounts escalate by birth order: 2.400 / 2.700 / 4.000 / 4.500.

inputSchema.label: Of those, children under 3
inputSchema.help: Each child under three adds a further 2.800 EUR to the family minimum.

inputSchema.label: Recognised degree of disability
inputSchema.help: Officially recognised degree of disability. Adds to the personal and family minimum.
